arrows.note: the definition is established; reading Y and Θ as the "rules" is the project connection (T-MM-RULES)

story.object: P = ℝᵐ for m outputs with metric Σ⁻¹; for a continuously indexed output with a stated inner product, a function space (L²). Not the parameter space Θ.
story.established: TMS 2010/2011 (data space); for the specific model e^{−θ₁T} + e^{−θ₂T} in L²(0, ∞) the Fisher metric is g_ij = 2/(θᵢ + θⱼ)³ (MMIh; example-specific, MMPk)
story.connection: "infinite prediction space" is exact as a function space: dim P = ∞ while dim M < ∞ (T-PREDICTION-INFINITE)
story.hypothesis: the larger space carries structure that one projection does not show (Interactive Master Map, Stage IV)
story.extension: not a quantum state space; not physical spacetime
story.falsify: none for the definition; the infinite reading needs a stated inner product

story.object: M = Y(Θ) ⊆ P, the model image (a set) in general; a smooth model manifold only on a regular region (constant local rank, locally injective). Rank loss, non-identifiability, self-intersections, singular strata and boundary strata can occur (MMPa, MMPb, MMPj). Induced metric g_θ = J_Yᵀ Σ⁻¹ J_Y
story.connection: "allowable manifold": the set of predictions the rules permit (an allowable family / image)
story.hypothesis: rules constrain a geometry of allowed states (T-RULES-GEOMETRY, open)
story.falsify: none for the definition; any statement that treats Y(Θ) as a smooth manifold must state its regular region

story.idea: Parameters vs model rule vs image
story.object: model rule Y (functional form); parameter domain Θ; parameter values θ ∈ Θ; predictions Y(θ); image M = Y(Θ). Parameters parameterize the image and give local coordinates only where the parameterization is locally regular and locally identifiable (MMPb); different θ may give the same prediction
story.established: local coordinates from an immersion that is locally injective (Lee 2018; Amari 2016)
story.connection: "the rules of the manifold were the model parameters." Unpacked: Y and Θ fix the allowable image; θ is a parameter value, a local coordinate only on regular identifiable regions; parameter limits can produce limiting strata of the image (T-MM-RULES, DERIVED)
story.hypothesis: governing rules play a broader role in allowable geometry (T-MM-RULES-Q)
story.falsify: a feature of the image that depends on the chart would contradict the unpacking (none: MMIa, MMIf, MMPf)

story.object: g_θ = J_Yᵀ Σ⁻¹ J_Y with J_Y = ∂Y/∂θ (fixed Σ): the component matrix of a symmetric (0,2)-tensor on Θ, the pullback of the prediction-space metric. Under θ = θ(φ), A = ∂θ/∂φ: g_φ = Aᵀ g_θ A (R1, MMPc); an isometry F*g = g (R2) exists only when the system supplies it
story.established: Rao 1945; Amari 2016; FB6a/FB6b; CFT4c and MMPc (R1 checked)
story.connection: placed in the Transformation Architecture: reparametrizations R1, isometries R2 (TA0)
story.falsify: a reparametrization reported as "g unchanged" (false for components)

story.object: g(v, v) = (J_Y v)ᵀ Σ⁻¹ (J_Y v); for positive-definite Σ⁻¹ (and fixed Σ), g(v, v) = 0 ⟺ J_Y v = 0 ⟺ g v = 0. Fails for a singular weight (MMPd) and for a θ-dependent noise law (MMPe). Kept apart: sloppy (λ small, nonzero), Lorentz null (vᵀηv = 0, ηv ≠ 0), bilinear null, collapsed zero, equal expectations, same-zero quantum states, symmetry-dependent distinctions
story.connection: "a zero geometric length can expose hidden non-identifiability / redundancy." (T-ZERO-LENGTH, DERIVED under the hypothesis); survives charts (CFT5d) and a change between fixed positive-definite weights (MMIe, MMPe)
story.extension: observable zero does not uniquely specify underlying state (T-QUANTUM-ZERO): a STRUCTURAL ANALOGUE, no map given
story.falsify: a zero-length direction along which predictions change (impossible for positive-definite fixed Σ⁻¹; possible otherwise, MMPd)

story.object: small nonzero eigenvalues of g in a stated chart; the raw spectrum is chart-dependent (MMIb, CFT5e). Invariant candidates: a geometric width hierarchy defined from the image (definition open, MMPg) or generalized eigenvalues of g relative to a system-supplied tensor h
story.established: Gutenkunst et al. 2007; TMS 2010; S14b (weak); S14a FAIL kept
story.connection: M1 restated: the spectrum is a statement in log-parameter coordinates
story.falsify: already weakened: raw eigenvalues are not geometric invariants (NEGATIVE result for any raw-spectrum comparison)

story.object: two width notions kept: Transtrum-style geodesic widths of the image (TMS 2011) and Quinn-style enclosing-hyperellipsoid widths / bounds, decaying geometrically for analytic models (Quinn et al. 2019). Either may be reparametrization-invariant when defined from the image set with a fixed prediction metric; widths taken along a chart's FIM eigendirections are not (MMPg). Exact definitions to be fixed from the source text
story.connection: C7 needs an explicitly defined geometric width object (T-C7, preconditions); both notions kept
story.hypothesis: C7: a structural relation between coefficient decay and a coordinate-independent width hierarchy (T-C7, OPEN)
story.falsify: a width definition that changes with the chart; a C7 result that reduces to Quinn 2019 (then VALIDATION OF KNOWN MATHEMATICS)

story.object: five objects kept apart: ∂Θ; parameter limits (e.g. θᵢ → ∞); their images in P; limiting boundary strata (MBAM sense); the topological boundary of Y(Θ) in P. A model-manifold boundary can arise as a limiting / degenerate model family in P as parameters approach appropriate limits (MMIg, MMPi, MMPj, MMPl)
story.connection: simpler structure as a boundary of a richer model (T-SIMPLER-BOUNDARY-Q)
story.falsify: treating every parameter-domain boundary as an image boundary (fails: MMPi) or a dimension drop as general (fails: MMPl)

story.object: the boundary model (e.g. e^{−θ₁t}); MBAM reaches it along a geodesic. In the Reduction architecture a limit is a degeneration of the family, not a map Φ: X → Y on states
story.connection: H6 / T-EFFECTIVE-Q examples; what survives: θ₁ (FB11c)
story.hypothesis: effective representations follow a general law (H6, OPEN)
story.falsify: an effective model not reachable as any boundary (would bound the reading; MBAM source-only)

story.object: P ⊋ M (the ambient contains predictions no parameter value reaches); a source X → reduced Y (Φ)
story.established: the strict inclusion is definitional; dim P = ∞ with dim M = 2 for the function-space example (MMIh, MMPk)
story.connection: "A mathematical space can contain more structure than a single visible projection reveals." (Stage IV carry-forward)
story.hypothesis: the larger possibility space is the right frame for the project (T-MM-STORY)
story.falsify: a system where the ambient adds nothing beyond M (would weaken the frame there)

story.object: a named information-changing map Φ: X → Y; quantum: the non-selective S² measurement D(ρ) = P_t ρ P_t + P_s ρ P_s, which removes the triplet–singlet coherence of |ud⟩ and keeps S_z = 0 because [P_t, S_z] = [P_s, S_z] = 0 (MMPn)
story.established: W2a, W2b, MMPn (established quantum mechanics); RIC1a (projection)
story.connection: observation as a map to a restricted manifestation (T-MM-OBSERVE, OPEN); measurement, projection, marginalization, quotient, limits, coarse-graining and non-identifiability are different operations (MMPo)
story.extension: "matter does not form until a viewer looks at it." (T-VIEWER-FORM: historical / project provenance; NOT ESTABLISHED PHYSICS); conscious observer requirement = NOT ESTABLISHED
story.falsify: a measurement whose effect is not representable as such a map (none known); for the viewer intuition: physical theory or data, not a construction

story.object: three roles of c kept apart: (1) representation: η_c = P_cᵀ diag(1, −1) P_c, P_c = diag(1, 1/c), for the stated matrix form; (2) invariant: Λ_cᵀ η_c Λ_c = η_c and the light cone in Lorentzian spacetime; (3) theory family: c → ∞ gives the degenerate limiting bilinear form diag(1, 0) (C9b, MMPm). Model side: in F-C, θ₂ → ∞ gives a 1-dimensional face (example-specific, MMPl)
story.established: C9a, C9b; Quinn et al. 2023 treat c as a model parameter whose c → ∞ boundary gives Newtonian kinematics (snippet-confirmed, PDF pending)
story.connection: theory-family singular limit: STRUCTURAL ANALOGY with model-family limits (T-RULES-GEOMETRY)
story.hypothesis: rules constrain a geometry of allowed states (T-RULES-GEOMETRY, open); the two roles of c (T-C-ROLES)
story.falsify: transfer of the invariant role to arbitrary model-manifold geometry is OPEN; diag(1, 0) is not by itself the Newtonian metric; the general phrase is too weak

story.object: a state space (density matrices on ℂ⁴ for two spins) and an observable; the S_z = 0 eigenspace is 2-dimensional, so a zero value does not fix the state (Q1a–Q1d)
story.established: Q1a, Q1c, Q1d, Q2b (established quantum mechanics)
story.connection: same zero ↔ observationally indistinguishable parameters: STRUCTURAL ANALOGUE / OPEN CONNECTION (no explicit map between the two)
story.extension: a richer state becoming an observable manifestation (T-VIEWER-FORM, normalized question)
story.falsify: an explicit map showing the two indistinguishabilities differ in kind (would bound the analogue)

story.object: the Reduction / Information-Changing Architecture (RI0): for each map, what survives, collapses, becomes zero, is lost, is reconstructible, the fibers, symmetry. The maps are different operations (MMPo)
story.connection: model-manifold boundaries join as limits (MMIg), the named S² channel as a map (W2a, MMPn)
story.hypothesis: transform vs reduce governs the project (T-TRANSFORM-REDUCE, open); whether the operations share a deeper pattern (open)
story.falsify: a reduction where the seven questions cannot be posed

story.object: for fixed positive-definite Σ⁻¹: Fisher length = local distinguishability per unit noise (MMId); fibers Y⁻¹(y) = parameters with identical predictions; information distinctions below
story.connection: geometry encodes accessible / inaccessible / indistinguishable information (T-GEOM-INFO-Q, open)
story.extension: what the geometry says about distinguishability in quantum measurement (open)
story.falsify: two parameter values with zero Fisher distance but distinguishable predictions (impossible locally for positive-definite fixed Σ⁻¹)

story.object: charts, noise metrics, embeddings: what changes (entries, det, √det g alone, raw Fisher / Hessian eigenvalues, condition number, singular values, chart-defined widths) and what stays under charts (rank, nullity for fixed positive-definite Σ⁻¹, length, the volume element, curvature, image-defined quantities)
story.falsify: a "geometric" claim that rests on a chart-dependent number (MMIb, MMPg show how it fails)

invariance.definition: g as a (0,2)-tensor on Θ; component matrix g_θ = J_Yᵀ Σ⁻¹ J_Y (J_Y = ∂Y/∂θ, fixed Σ)
invariance.coordinateInvariant: YES as a tensor; its component matrix changes: g_φ = Aᵀ g_θ A with A = ∂θ/∂φ (MMPc)
invariance.embedding: yes: the pullback of the prediction-space metric; changes with the outputs (sampling points) and their metric
invariance.reduction: yes: on a boundary it is the boundary model's metric (rank drops)
invariance.source: Rao 1945; Amari 2016; Lee 2018; FB6a, CFT4c, MMPc
invariance.failure: "g is unchanged" under reparametrization is false for components (CFT4c, MMPc)
invariance.c7: not itself C7's object

invariance.definition: components of g in a chart
invariance.coordinateInvariant: NO
invariance.embedding: yes: the pullback of the prediction-space metric; changes with the outputs (sampling points) and their metric
invariance.failure: θ = diag(1, 10)θ′ rescales the entries (MMIb)
invariance.c7: not an object for C7

invariance.definition: rank g = rank J_Y (positive-definite Σ⁻¹)
invariance.coordinateInvariant: YES under invertible reparametrizations
invariance.embedding: yes: too few outputs can lower it
invariance.noise: no for a change between fixed positive-definite weights (MMIe, MMPe); can change with a singular weight (MMPd) or a θ-dependent noise law (MMPe)
invariance.failure: a singular (non-invertible) chart change can lower it; a θ-dependent noise law can raise it (MMPe)
invariance.c7: the dimension of the regular part of the image

invariance.definition: ker g = ker J_Y for positive-definite fixed Σ⁻¹ (tangent vectors; they transform by A⁻¹)
invariance.coordinateInvariant: YES (as tangent vectors)
invariance.noise: no for a change between fixed positive-definite weights (MMIe, MMPe); can change with a singular weight (MMPd) or a θ-dependent noise law (MMPe)
invariance.failure: a singular weight adds nulls (MMPd); a θ-dependent covariance can remove them (MMPe)
invariance.c7: a null is a zero-width direction at a point

invariance.definition: eigenvalues of the component matrix g
invariance.coordinateInvariant: NO
invariance.c7: NEGATIVE: not C7's object

invariance.definition: eigenvalues of the cost Hessian ∂²C/∂θ² in a chart
invariance.coordinateInvariant: NO: off a critical point the Hessian matrix does not even transform as a tensor (H_λ = Aᵀ H_θ A + diag(θᵢ ∂C/∂θᵢ), MMPh)
invariance.failure: F-C at θ = (1, 3): the extra term is nonzero (MMPh)
invariance.c7: a chart proxy, not C7's object

invariance.definition: λ_max / λ_min of the component matrix
invariance.coordinateInvariant: NO
invariance.failure: moves under a change of units (MMIb)
invariance.c7: not an object for C7

invariance.definition: det g
invariance.coordinateInvariant: NO: det g_φ = (det A)² det g_θ
invariance.failure: any chart with det A ≠ ±1
invariance.c7: not an object for C7

invariance.definition: the density √det g without its coordinate differentials
invariance.coordinateInvariant: NO: it scales by |det A| (MMPf)
invariance.failure: F-C at θ = (1, 3): 0.0137649 in θ vs 0.0412947 in log θ (MMPf)
invariance.c7: not an object for C7

invariance.definition: the full element √det g_θ dθ¹⋯dθⁿ
invariance.coordinateInvariant: YES (change of variables: √det g_φ dφ¹⋯dφⁿ is the same element)
invariance.failure: total volume may be infinite (unbounded Θ)
invariance.c7: related to widths only heuristically; not carded

invariance.definition: ∫√(θ′ᵀ g_θ θ′) ds
invariance.coordinateInvariant: YES
invariance.embedding: yes: equals the arc length of the image curve in P (MMId)
invariance.failure: the same curve has another length under another noise model (MMIf)

invariance.definition: Gaussian curvature K of the induced metric on a regular region (intrinsic); extrinsic curvature of the image in P

invariance.c7: background for widths (source-only)

invariance.definition: singular values of J_Y (= √eig(J_Yᵀ J_Y) in a Euclidean chart)
invariance.coordinateInvariant: NO
invariance.failure: θ vs log θ vs Σ = diag(1, 2, 3) give three different sets (MMIc)

invariance.definition: Euclidean extents along the axes of a chosen parameter chart
invariance.coordinateInvariant: NO: a chart quantity by definition (Δθ = 1 on θ ∈ [1, 2] is Δλ = log 2 in λ = log θ)
invariance.failure: any rescaling of a coordinate
invariance.c7: a chart proxy, not a width

invariance.quantity: Widths along a chart's FIM eigendirections

invariance.definition: widths of a hyperellipsoid enclosing the image, bounded through Chebyshev approximation (Quinn et al. 2019; definition to be taken from the source text)

invariance.failure: MMPi

notation.A: A = ∂θ/∂φ, the Jacobian of a reparametrization θ = θ(φ)
notation.g: g_θ = J_Yᵀ Σ⁻¹ J_Y (Gaussian noise with a fixed covariance Σ)
notation.tensor: g is one symmetric (0,2)-tensor on Θ; g_θ and g_φ are its component matrices in two charts. The components change; the tensor does not
notation.older: earlier records (CF13, BR41, the Transformation Architecture) write the coordinate-change Jacobian as J in g_φ = Jᵀ g J; there J = ∂θ/∂φ = A, not J_Y

structure.image: M = Y(Θ) ⊆ P is the model image / model set, in full generality
structure.manifold: it may be called a smooth model manifold on a regular region only: constant local rank and local injectivity (immersion plus embedding-type conditions)

parameters.value: θ ∈ Θ is a parameter value in parameter space
parameters.point: Y(θ) is the corresponding prediction / model point

nullTheorem.statement: g(v, v) = vᵀ J_Yᵀ Σ⁻¹ J_Y v = (J_Y v)ᵀ Σ⁻¹ (J_Y v); for positive-definite Σ⁻¹, g(v, v) = 0 ⟺ J_Y v = 0
nullTheorem.hypothesis: Σ⁻¹ positive definite (and Σ fixed, not θ-dependent)
fails: a singular observation weight: J_Y v ≠ 0 with g(v, v) = 0 (MMPd)
a θ-dependent noise law: J_μ v = 0 with g(v, v) = 1/2 (MMPe)

noise.theorem: For g = J_Yᵀ Σ⁻¹ J_Y with a fixed positive-definite Σ⁻¹: ker g = ker J_Y and rank g = rank J_Y. Changing one positive-definite weighting to another does not change those null directions / rank.
caveats: parameter-dependent covariance: the full Fisher information must be computed (MMPe)
noise laws that contribute additional Fisher terms (MMPe: ∇s∇sᵀ/(2s²))

volume.invariant: the full element √det g_θ dθ¹⋯dθⁿ (= √det g_φ dφ¹⋯dφⁿ)

boundary.object: a family θ(r) with, e.g., θᵢ → ∞

boundary.notion: limiting boundary stratum / reduced-model boundary (MBAM sense)

boundary.notion: ordinary topological boundary of Y(Θ) in P

boundaryRules: These five are not automatically identical.
A model-manifold boundary can arise as a limiting/degenerate model family in prediction space as parameters approach appropriate limits.
Not every parameter-domain boundary gives a distinct model-manifold boundary (MMPi).
Not every model-manifold boundary should be described as an ordinary finite boundary point in parameter coordinates (MMPi, MMPj).

functionSpace.scope: the Fisher metric of the specific continuous-output model Y(T) = e^{−θ₁T} + e^{−θ₂T} in L²(0, ∞) (white noise per unit time); not a general formula

roles.statement: varying c between theories, c → ∞ is a singular theory limit: η_c → diag(1, 0), a degenerate limiting bilinear form (rank 1, zero on every purely spatial displacement); no change of representation within one finite-c form reaches it; the boost generator contracts to a shear
roles.note: diag(1, 0) is not by itself "the Newtonian metric": Galilean / Newton–Cartan structure requires more than this rank-one limit. Model-side comparison: in F-C, θ₂ → ∞ gives a 1-dimensional face; that dimension drop is a result of the specific example (MMPl)

quantumChannel.name: non-selective projective measurement of total spin S²
quantumChannel.map: D(ρ) = P_t ρ P_t + P_s ρ P_s
quantumChannel.observable: S², with spectral projectors P_t (triplet) and P_s (singlet)
quantumChannel.removed: the off-diagonal terms ⟨1,0|ρ|0,0⟩ = ⟨0,0|ρ|1,0⟩ = 1/2: the coherence between the triplet and singlet eigenspaces
quantumChannel.preserved: S_z = 0, because [P_t, S_z] = [P_s, S_z] = 0 and S_z ρ = 0 give S_z D(ρ) = 0
quantumChannel.counterexample: the non-selective S_x⁽¹⁾ measurement on the same state gives Tr(S_z E(ρ)) = −ħ/2: preservation is not generic
quantumChannel.generic: A non-selective projective measurement in a specified basis removes coherence between the measured eigenspaces. Preservation of a quantity such as S_z requires the relevant state/channel/observable relation to be checked explicitly.

corrections.old: "The model manifold is M = Y(Θ) ⊆ P."
corrections.new: M = Y(Θ) ⊆ P is the model image / model set in general; it is a smooth model manifold on a regular region only (constant local rank, locally injective). Rank loss, non-identifiability, self-intersections, singular strata and boundary strata are possible.
corrections.reason: an immersion's image can self-intersect and a rank drop can make a cusp (MMPa); the F-C image has an edge from interior rank-drop points (MMPj)

corrections.old: "A parameter value is a coordinate on M." / "θ is a point coordinate."
corrections.new: θ ∈ Θ is a parameter value; Y(θ) is its prediction. Parameters parameterize the image and give local coordinates only where the parameterization is locally regular and locally identifiable; different parameter values may represent the same prediction.
corrections.reason: F-C: Y(1, 2) = Y(2, 1); rank 1 on the diagonal; e^{−(θ₁+θ₂)t} has rank 1 everywhere (MMPb)

corrections.old: g = JᵀΣ⁻¹J and g_φ = Jᵀ g J (one symbol J for two Jacobians)
corrections.new: J_Y = ∂Y/∂θ, g_θ = J_Yᵀ Σ⁻¹ J_Y; A = ∂θ/∂φ, g_φ = Aᵀ g_θ A. The tensor is one object; g_θ and g_φ are its component matrices.
corrections.reason: notation clash; the law itself was right (MMPc checks it directly)
supersedes: model-manifold records; CF13, BR41 and the Transformation Architecture keep J = ∂θ/∂φ with a notation note

corrections.new: g(v, v) = (J_Y v)ᵀ Σ⁻¹ (J_Y v); for positive-definite Σ⁻¹, g(v, v) = 0 ⟺ J_Y v = 0. Not for singular metrics or arbitrary observation models.
corrections.reason: a singular weight gives g(v, v) = 0 with J_Y v ≠ 0 (MMPd)

corrections.old: "Rank and null directions do not depend on the noise model."
corrections.new: For g = J_Yᵀ Σ⁻¹ J_Y with a fixed positive-definite Σ⁻¹: ker g = ker J_Y, rank g = rank J_Y; changing one positive-definite weighting to another does not change them. Not claimed for singular observation metrics, parameter-dependent covariances, or noise laws that add Fisher terms.

corrections.old: "√det g dθ is invariant" (density and element not separated)
corrections.new: The invariant object is the full element √det g_θ dθ¹⋯dθⁿ. det g and √det g alone change under reparametrization (by (det A)² and |det A|).
corrections.reason: √det g changes from 0.0137649 to 0.0412947 at one point while the volume of a region agrees in both charts (MMPf)

corrections.old: "Widths are invariant under reparametrization." / "Hyperribbon widths: parametrization-independent."
corrections.new: Geometric widths defined from the image set with a fixed prediction metric (Transtrum-style geodesic widths with geometrically fixed directions; Quinn-style enclosing-hyperellipsoid widths) may be reparametrization-invariant. Coordinate proxies (raw Fisher / Hessian eigenvalues, J_Y singular values, parameter-axis lengths, condition numbers, widths along a chart's FIM eigendirections) are not.
corrections.reason: FIM eigendirections rotate with the chart (MMPg); the exact width definitions have not been taken from the sources

corrections.old: "The limits of the parameter domain are the boundaries of the model manifold."
corrections.new: Five objects are kept apart: ∂Θ; parameter limits; their images in P; limiting boundary strata (MBAM sense); the topological boundary of Y(Θ). A model-manifold boundary can arise as a limiting / degenerate model family in P; not every parameter-domain boundary gives one, and not every one is a finite boundary point in parameter coordinates.
corrections.reason: MMPi (chart-dependent finite points; a domain boundary mapping inside the image; empty interior in P); MMPj (an edge from interior points)

corrections.old: g_ij = 2/(θᵢ + θⱼ)³ stated beside "function-space prediction space"
corrections.new: g_ij = 2/(θᵢ + θⱼ)³ is the Fisher metric of the specific model e^{−θ₁T} + e^{−θ₂T} in L²(0, ∞); dim P = ∞ while dim M = 2.
corrections.reason: θ₁e^{−T} + θ₂e^{−2T} in the same space has a constant metric (MMPk)

corrections.old: "A finite c is just a change of units"; "FAIL for the invariant-form role"; "sending one model parameter to infinity drops dimension 2 → 1"
corrections.new: Three roles kept apart: Role 1 representation-level normalization (established for the stated form); Role 2 the Lorentzian invariant role (established physics in its native setting); Role 3 the theory-family singular limit (structural analogy worth preserving). Transfer to arbitrary model-manifold geometry: OPEN. The universal "rules constrain states" reading: too weak by itself. c → ∞ gives a degenerate limiting bilinear form, not by itself the Newtonian metric. The 2 → 1 drop is a result of the F-C example.
corrections.reason: MMIi checks a representation only; no representation change reaches diag(1, 0) (MMPm); dimension drops depend on the model and the limit (MMPl)

corrections.old: "non-selective measurement keeps S_z = 0 and removes coherence between sectors" (stated generically)
corrections.new: The named channel D(ρ) = P_t ρ P_t + P_s ρ P_s (non-selective S² measurement) on |ud⟩ removes ⟨1,0|ρ|0,0⟩ = ⟨0,0|ρ|1,0⟩ = 1/2; S_z = 0 survives because [P_t, S_z] = [P_s, S_z] = 0 and S_z ρ = 0. Generic form: a non-selective projective measurement removes coherence between the measured eigenspaces; preservation of S_z must be checked.
corrections.reason: a non-selective S_x⁽¹⁾ measurement on the same state gives ⟨S_z⟩ = −ħ/2 (MMPn)

corrections.old: observation, projection and boundary limits listed together as instances of one arrow
corrections.new: Quantum measurement, projection, marginalization, quotient / reduction, manifold boundary limits, coarse graining and parameter non-identifiability are different operations. Whether they share a deeper structural pattern is OPEN; it is NOT established that they are the same operation.
corrections.reason: they differ in what they act on and in idempotence (MMPo)

corrections.old: arrow statuses in the seven-class vocabulary only
corrections.new: every arrow also carries a status in ESTABLISHED MATHEMATICS / PROJECT-DERIVED / STRUCTURAL ANALOGY / OPEN / PHILOSOPHICAL / HISTORICAL INTUITION; cross-links and the viewer intuition included

nine kinds kept distinct: J_Y v = 0, zero Fisher length (equivalent only under its hypothesis), sloppy (not a null), Lorentz null, bilinear null, collapsed zero, equal expectations, same-zero quantum example, symmetry-dependent distinction (independently supplied symmetry only)
corrections.reason: no one type of nullity is universal

corrections.new: C7 requires an explicitly defined geometric width object; both Transtrum-style and Quinn-style notions are kept; five preconditions fixed before derivation. C7 is not "hyperribbon widths exist". T-C7 stays OPEN.
corrections.reason: a width object was named before its definition was fixed, and widths were called parametrization-independent without separating proxies (MMPg)
